# Jack Jaillet

> Personal site of Jack Jaillet (he/him), a business student at UMass Amherst's Isenberg School of Management (class of 2030), founder of Charming Memories Photography, multimedia director for the MassSTAR youth leadership conference, and the 2024-25 Massachusetts Leo of the Year (Lions Clubs International, District 33A). Based in Massachusetts.

Contact: contact@jackjaillet.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jackjaillet/

## Pages

- [About](https://jackjaillet.com/about): background, where Jack is involved, and why he does the work
- [Resume](https://jackjaillet.com/resume): experience, leadership, education, honors, skills and certifications
- [Services](https://jackjaillet.com/services): Signature Studio (a free email signature builder) and photography
- [Blog](https://jackjaillet.com/blog/): longer writing (no posts yet)

## Key facts

- Education: UMass Amherst, Isenberg School of Management (started fall 2026, major undeclared); Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School, Business Technology, class of 2026 (Class Treasurer and Secretary, National Honor Society)
- Founder, Charming Memories Photography (since November 2024): portrait, event, headshot, real estate, sports and corporate photography
- Board Multimedia Director, Massachusetts Youth Leadership Foundation (since November 2025); Conference Multimedia Director for MassSTAR 2025 and 2026
- Client Service Associate (internship), Bright Future Financial LLC, Leominster MA (since February 2025)
- Certified Trainer and Consultant, Training Active Bystanders (since July 2023)
- Consultant, Gathering Currents (since September 2025)
- Founder, LGBTQIA Safe Zone (since April 2021)
